title: Stalled-consumer eviction voided the [settled] at-least-once trigger delivery guarantee
evidence: See the validation pass report; each finding cites file:line in the corpus and crates.
resolution: Ruled: eviction applies to mirror cursors only. Listener cursors and archive sinks are never evicted, and a client-first mirror is non-evictable because the device is the authoritative store. A stalled listener dead-letters (lossless, already specified); one that should stop pinning the floor is deregistered. Spec §7 and engine-plan's acceptance criterion amended so at-least-once and the floor rule stay one sentence.

title: Client-first has no compaction rule: snapshots named once, no cadence, no load-from-snapshot, no discard
evidence: See the validation pass report; each finding cites file:line in the corpus and crates.
resolution: Ruled: `policy vault { snapshot every 5000 commands or 7d, keep 3 }`. Snapshots sealed client-side, chained and server-sequenced like proposals, so verifiable rather than trusted; cold start loads the newest openable snapshot and folds forward; segments below the newest snapshot every enrolled device acknowledged may be discarded, with enrolled devices non-evictable and un-enrolment the remedy. Added as F7 (ordo-vault) in engine-plan.md.
